items: Use member wikilinks such as `[[@username]]` to link directly to member profiles.
Use tag wikilinks such as `[[#tagname]]` to link directly to tag pages.
Get autocomplete suggestions for members and tags when typing `[[@` or `[[#` in the Markdown editor.
Member, tag, and page wikilinks are preserved consistently when content is edited and displayed.
Unrecognized tag wikilinks remain visible as literal text instead of disappearing.
